units.title: Actual compact weak Poisson: original weighted gradient domain and scalar coercivity

sources.label: PBPS AppendixC.1 authored analytic prerequisite
sources.scope: Derive genuine compact weighted L2/AE classes vW/GW/AW for actual v/G/(innergradWG-F), same original D.closure graph membership and lambda*normGW^2<=normAW^2 via actual same ordinary-to-weighted smooth sequence. Source fixes originalD before epsilon/f and ONEu before ALLC2chi. No supplied weighted domain/core/convergence/coercivity certificate; no rough classical Hessian or full adjoint/generator-core identity, globalcutoff/tail/Bochner,epsilon0/kernel/range/noncompactlinear/Poincare/BL/jointmeasurablechoice/main/composition. Reflected quarter/fourfold constants exact. TV never transfers unbounded cost.

assumptions: Finite-dimensional real Hilbert/Borel E, canonical full-space volume, including dimension zero. W is C2, exp(-W) genuinely integrable with positive Z. The actual given measure mu equals volume.tilted(-W), hence is the normalized Gibbs law. The Hessian quadratic form is bounded below by m times squared norm for every point/vector; m is any real number, not necessarily positive.

The original partial real-linear gradient D on actual weighted L2 is closable. Its graph consists exactly of AE classes of C-infinity compact functions and their genuine classical gradients. This is an original structural interface, not a supplied final closure-domain, coercivity, adjoint or core certificate.

Pointwise real v,F and vector G are global ordinary-volume MemLp2 with topological supports in the same compact K. Every real C1 compact psi/every direction a has both legal L1 products and integral psi*inner(G,a)=-integral v*D_a psi. Every real C2 compact psi has both legal L1 products and integral v*Delta psi=integral F*psi. No approximation, weighted class/convergence, domain membership or scalar inequality is an input.
units.statement: From the stated genuine compact weak data and original gradient interface, Derive actual weighted MemLp2 of v,G,A=inner(gradientW,G)-F. Return actual vW,AW,GW L2 classes with all three mu-AE links, (vW,GW) in the SAME D.closure graph, and m*norm(GW)^2<=norm(AW)^2. The actual ordinary smooth sequence, common compact weighted transfer and generator-gradient limits are produced internally. This is compact scalar coercivity, not a rough Hessian, full Bochner/adjoint/operator-core identity, global cutoff result, epsilon-zero/Poincare/BL or complete main theorem.

steps.title: Derive one actual ordinary smooth graph sequence
steps.text: Apply the accepted compact weak-Poisson graph producer to genuine supports/L2 and both weak equations. It constructs ONE real Schwartz sequence with common compact Kprime and simultaneous function, gradient and Laplacian limits. It does not assert K is inside Kprime; take Kbar=K union Kprime. All gradient/Laplacian supports of the smooth terms lie in Kprime by derivative locality, including dimension zero.

steps.title: Bound the true normalized density and local drift on that same compact
steps.text: Continuity yields finite upper bounds for rho=exp(-W)/Z and norm(gradientW) on Kbar. Use the actual tilted with-density definition and restriction/measure monotonicity to prove mu.restrict(Kbar)<=c*volume. The normalized measure is genuine probability from actual integrability; no global bounded drift, tails or position moments are assumed.
steps.formula: \mu|_{\bar K}\le c\,dx,\quad c<\infty,\quad\|\nabla W(x)\|\le M\ (x\in\bar K).

steps.title: Produce weighted L2 classes and the same three norm limits
steps.text: Support-restricted seminorm and finite measure domination imply actual weighted MemLp for every compact-supported datum and term, then norm_mu(error)<=sqrt(c)*norm_dx(error). Indicator/restriction and quotient subtraction are handled explicitly. Squeeze all three errors to zero using the SAME sequence; convergence is in true L2 quotients, not pointwise. The bound is stated using exact ENNReal exponent/toReal operations at p=2.

steps.title: Derive the actual drift and generator convergence
steps.text: Inner-product norm and the compact drift bound supply measurable MemLp of inner(gradientW,G) and every approximant. Prove the same bound for actual differences, identify toLp subtraction by all AE links, and squeeze drift errors. Subtract the weighted Laplacian limits to produce A_n=inner(gradientW,gradientphi_n)-Deltaphi_n -> A; rough G and F are never classically differentiated.

steps.title: Pass the same function-gradient pairs through the original closed graph
steps.text: Each actual phi_n is compact C-infinity, so the original exact graph characterization puts its AE-linked weighted function/gradient pair in D.graph. Product convergence and closability put the limiting pair in the topological graph closure, exactly D.closure.graph. No new gradient domain or final-domain premise replaces the original D.

steps.title: Normalize the actual compact Bochner inequality exactly once
steps.text: Apply the accepted C2-potential/compact-smooth Bochner identity and its arbitrary-real curvature consequence to each phi_n. Its L=Delta-innerdrift is minus A_n, so squared scalars agree. The true tilted integral divides by positive Z exactly once; norm-square integrals use actual MemLp/AE links. No second-derivative limit or rough Hessian identification is needed for this scalar inequality.

steps.title: Pass both actual norms to the limit and expose the exact boundary
steps.text: Norm and squaring are continuous; the simultaneous weighted gradient and generator limits pass each scalar inequality to the original G/A. Return actual weighted MemLp and three AE-linked quotient classes with same-D closure membership. Signed m is permitted. The result is a local scalar prerequisite, with no global/core/adjoint/Poincare/BL or source-completion claim.
